description:
The ultimate enduro e-MTB. Refined handling and chaos-taming suspension in a flawless package. Designed for riders who want the very best components money can buy on a reliable, tough and versatile machine that's ready for racing and riding.

The LITHOS 10K is our ultimate enduro e-MTB. Our carbon fibre frame keeps mass low for refined handling, along with a new geometry that maximises traction and control on the toughest, roughest trails. With the lightweight but hugely powerful 120 Nn Bosch CX-R drive unit and a high-capacity 800 Wh battery, it's got the power to tackle big mountain adventures and multi-stage race tracks, while the smart Fox DHX Live Valve NEO coil-sprung rear shock automatically adjusts damping support for speed and efficiency. Up front, there's a buttery smooth inverted Fox Podium fork, while bulletproof DT Swiss carbon wheels and SRAM's wireless X0 Eagle drivetrain round out a dream spec.

Even in the most imposing terrain, it is possible to find flow. Named after the Ancient Greek for rock or stone, the LITHOS is designed for serious enduro riders and racers, with a single-minded focus on speed, no matter what turn the trail takes.

With a full carbon frame and 170 mm of travel at either end, it’s built for the toughest tracks, pushing hard with friends and racing against the clock. The handling has been engineered to help you carry speed, no matter what the gradient or ground. The geometry is made to maximise traction on flat turns and confidence on steep sections with a longer chainstay and higher stack, while travel-adjustable dropper posts and our AGILOMETER sizing mean you can fine-tune fit and handling.

Because you need absolute faith in your setup for flat-out technical riding, we doubled down on versatility, durability and reliability when creating the LITHOS. That’s why we use the latest Bosch CX and CX Race drive units plus 600 and 800 Wh batteries, giving big-brand performance with proven worldwide sales support.

You can run a lightweight 600 Wh battery for agile handling or a high-capacity 800 Wh for the big days, plus it’s possible to route the cables cleanly through our WIRE PORT or semi-externally via headtube ports if you need rapid access. We also give the choice of running a full 29” setup for flat-out speed or the standard mixed 29/27.5” setup to retain plenty of agility, while both air and coil rear shocks will work perfectly.
